# Stumble installation instructions for agents

Stumble requires Rust and Cargo. If `cargo` is missing, ask the user to install Rust from https://rustup.rs before continuing.

From the repository root, install the CLI:

```bash
cargo install --path crates/stumble-cli --locked
```

Initialize a Home Node and verify the installation:

```bash
podctl --data-dir ~/.stumble/nodes/default init-node
podctl --data-dir ~/.stumble/nodes/default node-info
```

Start the local HTTP API only when the User asks to run it:

```bash
podctl --data-dir ~/.stumble/nodes/default serve
```

Keep the default loopback binding unless the user explicitly requests and understands public exposure. Use `podctl --help` and `podctl <command> --help` for the complete CLI contract.
